features.name: three parallel lanes
features.notes: Classically three parallel routes across the map
features.quote: Lane Network: Parallel routes, classically three

features.name: lane pinch point
features.quote: Narrow transitions where lanes meet, concentrating fights into contested ground.

features.name: breachable exterior building
features.notes: House apartment or compound accessible from outside
features.quote: A house, apartment, or compound entered from outside.

features.name: explorable 3D world
features.notes: Fully modeled dimensional environment rather than flat 2D scene

features.name: undead enemy vehicles
features.notes: Creepy zombie themed cars tanks or similar vehicles driving through the world
features.quote: creepy zombie-themed enemy vehicles that drive toward them through the world

features.name: unique detailed vehicle models
features.notes: Enemy vehicles should visibly differ from one another
features.quote: Each enemy vehicle must be a unique, detailed 3D model

features.name: nonhumanoid vehicle enemies
features.notes: No walking humanoid zombies or flat sprite enemies
features.quote: The enemies are vehicles ... not humanoid zombies, not walking characters, and not flat 2D sprites

excluded.name: first person camera
excluded.why: camera perspective rather than map content
